notes.title: [Deployed] Regular update - Alpha 1.3-earlyaccess
notes.notes:
Space Commanders,

A new update has been deployed.
This update brings some new features regarding the user experience:

[h2]Build mode interface[/h2]

In this version, the visual interface of the construction mode has benefited from several additions:
- New element highlighting
- New information window of constructible objects with "move" and "destroy" actions
- New compartment cell information window with "expand compartment" and "remove compartment cell" actions
- New construction grid information in order to know the necessary size of a compartment (green grid) and the necessary outer space (white grid) to place certain elements.
- Addition of an explanatory text, of the "tooltip" type, on the reasons for the impossibility of placing an element.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655647/a34bf765b1f821101f766b2015f332745168cfb5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655647/f817d118244e1bfc8532838f9399d91cd1259d50.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655647/f5365ddd0d1a5ee15c2118deae5ab3e16e2d753b.png[/img]

[h2]New tutorial[/h2]

In order to understand these new features, the tutorial has been reviewed and completed.

[h2]Management of resource extractor missions[/h2]

You can now define the duration of a mission on a planet but also cancel it at any time by immediately recalling the residents left on a planet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655647/95d7b89a950b14021fec541ada3f1a18d8d625b7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655647/b83622253a8ef1aee7089d8f420d83ed856dc480.png[/img]


[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]

A few bugs have been fixed:

- Fixed the calculation of the oxygen stock which did not take into account the production
- Fixed drone AI getting stuck
- Fixed non-buildable areas of the grid (red grid) not being reloaded after loading a game
- Fixed items consuming resources when not yet built
- Fixed a bug that saved cells being drawn during an autosave
- Fixed the display of planet previews in the "Galaxy" tab of the navigation interface
- Fixed some texts that were only displayed in French
- Fixed docking bay resource extractor selector not showing default selection
- Fixed UI scaling
- Fixed a crash that sometimes occurred after exiting passengers from a resource extraction spaceship
- Fixed the history of resource variations which made the calculation of variations over 24H erroneous
- Fixed energy production bonuses not being applied on resource stats display
- Fixed docking bay power consumption being half the displayed value
- Fixed food consumption not being reduced after creating a dish in the kitchen
- Fixed docking bay remaining accessible to Residents while disabled
- Fixed "power-off" icon not being displayed for reactors
- Fixed game save list UI shifting to the right after the 1st display


FYI: Dialogs with NPCs will be reactivated in the next update.

Thank you for your contributions.

We are counting on you Space Commanders.
Good luck !

notes.title: [Deployed] Regular update - Alpha 1.2-earlyaccess
notes.notes:
Space Commanders,

A new update has been deployed.
This update brings a lot of new features and reworked game code.
In this context, all your previous saves are no longer compatible with this version:

[h2]Construction drones[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655647/abde6cf45f29c9ad98f879508b9437289841cb37.gif[/img]

In this version, construction mode is updated with the addition of construction drones. Now, when you place compartment cells or buildable items, they will no longer appear instantly as was the case previously. You will now have to wait for the construction drones to manufacture your elements.

[h2]New mouse interactions[/h2]

Mouse selection of objects and residents has been rewritten to be more understandable and intuitive for players.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655647/b04b078b2603a91a05027a12a2a9debdf90ca0f1.gif[/img]


[h2]Other additions[/h2]

- Added tooltip text on mouse hover on some items showing values
- Added new music tracks
- Added new sound effects for UI and build mode


[h2]Changes[/h2]

- Some mission objectives have been adjusted
- The profession required for the astral scanner has been changed to "Engineer" with the associated skill
- HUD appearance has been improved
- The appearance of the Earth has been improved
- The time is no longer displayed in the HUD
- Fast mode speed has been reduced to avoid bugs in AI pathfinding
- Graphics quality settings have been adjusted


[h2]Performance improvement[/h2]

The game is currently in an important phase of optimizing the code of the essential features of the game. And this, in order to improve the integration of future features.
In this version, the game startup has been reworked and the UI state machine rewritten.
Also, the game code relating to items that can be used by resident AIs has been reworked to reduce CPU usage.


[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]

Also, the focus is on fixing the bugs you reported. As you may have noticed, there hasn't been a fix patch since the last regular update. Indeed, the game was already in its phase of optimization and rewriting of certain game codes. And to avoid programming patches that would have been obsolete with the update to version 1.2-earlyaccess, bug fixes have therefore been carried out on this regular version.

- Fixed the position of the "sleeping" animation in the bunk beds
- Fixed NPC animation state change that switches from "Officer" profession to another profession
- Fixed audio settings not always being saved
- Fixed some clothing textures
- Correction of the change of profession button from the resident sheet
- Fixed game save loading
- Fixed not working camera bounds
- Fixed some translations
- Fixed the allocation of resources at the time of the first warp drive
- Fixed construction mode when doors are sometimes replaced by walls randomly
- Fixed Resource Extractor count not being displayed in the Population tab
- Fixed items not being able to be deleted while in use
- Fixed Resident stuck in "working" state when their workplace is disabled
- Fixed energy generator continuing to generate energy when disabled
- Fixed reactor not consuming energy
- Fixed the build mode which allowed to build objects in the docking bay


[h2]Player suggestions added[/h2]

One of the most received feedbacks was about the management of resource extractors. So the way to send resource extractors to harvest resources on a planet has been reworked.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655647/edfdcab5f6ebbd934d3e1f2a842b59ee04ef5f91.png[/img]

From now on, you will have to assign the residents who have the profession of resource extractor from the information window of the docking bay to prepare them for their mission. While remembering to mark the planet as a resource extraction destination from the Navigation tab.

Other suggestions have been added:
- Added keyboard support for camera controls
- Improved contrast for the tracked mission HUD
- Added shortcuts for direct access to Resources and Population tabs
- Added highlighting of the resident when hovering over his name from the list of residents
- Added more information in the resident list to make it easier to compare skills

FYI: Dialogs with NPCs are temporarily disabled in view of an upcoming feature addition.

Thank you for your contributions.

We are counting on you Space Commanders.
Good luck !

notes.title: [Deployed] Regular Update - Alpha 1.1-earlyaccess
notes.notes:
Space Commanders,

After several weeks and a bit of a delay (again), the 1.1 update is now available.
Warning : Previous saves are no longer compatible due to new stars procedural generation

Here are the new features it brings:

[h2]Space navigation[/h2]

The rest of the main mission is unlocked, so you can add the reactors on your spaceship as well as the astral scanner and trigger the interstellar jump sequence from the navigation menu of the Command Center.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655647/71f5106675f921eab95b7e98ad6e4d45681469a1.png[/img]

The navigation menu also allows you to navigate between planets of the same system, launch a probe on a planet and then flag this planet as a target for resource extraction.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655647/63266e2c3336462cd15f4ac9c5c663ddaeaaeb2f.png[/img]

The star systems to be discovered are procedurally generated. Each time you start a new game, a new galaxy containing thousands of stars is generated.

All stars can be visited (if they are within warp drive range) and all planets of these stars can be explored from space.

[h2]Resource extraction[/h2]

Thanks to the Astral Scanner, you can obtain information on the type of astra and the available resources of a planet.

If a planet has extractable resources (water, oxygen, materials), then you can flag that planet as a resource extraction target for resource extraction ships.

To be able to carry out the extraction missions, you will have to start the construction of Docking Bays for the resource extraction ships.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655647/218ca803559dc4d5e09a52cf8efbc863e423eec1.jpg[/img]

These spaceships are piloted by residents who will have the Resource Extractor profession.

[h2]Player Suggestions[/h2]

Also, thanks to your feedback, several ideas and improvements have been implemented in the game:

[h3]Building UI/UX improvement[/h3]

New visual aids have been added to improve understanding and user experience during construction.
Here is the list:

- Add visual information to indicate when it is possible to rotate equipment
- Add an imaginary vertical line when placing ceiling lights to better position them

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40655647/e6237aac73655c51c6d3d31ad94bb60baf325778.png[/img]

[h3]The information window for equipment[/h3]

This window was already provided in the development but, following your suggestions, it is presented differently.
For equipment that produces and/or consumes resources (power generators, kitchens, etc.), an information window is therefore available by clicking on one of these devices.

This window allows the following functions:

- Enable/Disable the equipment
- View production/consumption information
- Get help on its operation and the necessary job

[h3]Tutorial enrichment (Postponned)[/h3]

Regarding the enrichment of the tutorial, it will be implemented when the majority of the features related to the build mode will be fully developed.

[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]

- Fixed bug where NPC stuck in their bed after game
- Fixed farmpod collisions
- Fixed mission tasks display
- Fixed autosave in inappropriate moments
- Fixed HUD text size
- Fixed pause menu unavailable at character creation screen
- Fixed kitchen bug which prevent NPC to take available meals
- Fixed mission status after game load
- Fixed invisible NPC after game load

Thank you for your contributions.

We are counting on you Space Commanders.
Good luck !

notes.title: [Deployed] Hotfix update - Alpha 1.0.1-earlyaccess
notes.notes:
The update brings the following fixes:

- Fixed a rendering issue on screens with a resolution higher than 1080p
- Fixed a crash when building a compartment (The game gets stuck in build mode)
- Fixed a bug in the first tutorial mission where it was possible to remove all cells from the first compartment
- Fixed an issue in dialogues with NPCs that blocked the flow of discussion
- Fixed an issue with displays with a ratio other than 16:9
- Fixed a bug making keyboard and mouse inputs inoperative on the GUI
- Fixed non-constructible areas that were not reset after destruction
- Fixed a bug making it possible to speak with deceased NPCs

This update is available now.

Continue to send your feedback from the game, the forums or on discord.
It is thanks to your contributions that the game will progress!

notes.title: [Planned] Hotfix update - Alpha 1.0.1-earlyaccess
notes.notes:
Thanks to all the players who participate in this early access!

A few of you are affected by critical bugs that require hotfixes.
Here is the list:

- Screen resolution problem on certain display categories
- Crash during the first mission
- Problem in dialogues with NPCs which blocks the flow of the discussion
- Crash on compartment building (Game stuck on build mode))

This update will be deployed very soon.
Other issues will be fixed for the next regular update.

Continue to send your feedback from the game, the forums or on discord.
It is thanks to your contributions that the game will progress!
